<?php
function peerShift216() { global $late, $owner, $runner; $late = 99; $owner = null; $runner = null; echo 'SHIFT;'; return false; }
class PeerScopeBase216 { public string $text; public function __construct($text) { $this->text = $text; echo 'CTOR;'; } public function capture($saved, $marker) { echo 'WRONG;'; return $this; } public function run() { global $owner, $late; return $owner->MiSsInG(first: ($this->capture(...))($late, peerShift216()), later: false); } public function __destruct() { echo 'THIS-END;'; } }
class PeerScopeMid216 extends PeerScopeBase216 { public function capture($saved, $marker) { $this->text = $saved; echo 'PRODUCER:', self::class, ':', static::class, ';'; return $this; } }
class PeerScopeChild216 extends PeerScopeMid216 {}
class PeerBase216 { public function __call(string $name, array $arguments) { global $alias; $alias = 0; echo 'MAGIC;'; return new class($arguments, $name) { public function __construct(public array $saved, public string $name) {} public function __destruct() { echo 'CHILD;'; } }; } public function __destruct() { echo 'OWNER;'; } }
class PeerDerived216 extends PeerBase216 {}
$owner = new PeerDerived216; $prefix = 'REQUEST-'; $late = $prefix . 'OLD'; $alias =& $late; $runner = new PeerScopeChild216($late);
$child = $runner->run();
echo 'RETURN;'; unset($alias); unset($late); echo 'VALUE:', $child->saved['first']->text, ':', $child->name, ';'; unset($child); echo 'AFTER;';
